titulo: Danish MPs approve Greenland security pact with US
cuerpo: Danish foreign minister says deal ‘removes all uncertainty’ over territory but warns trust in US needs rebuilding Europe live – latest updates The Danish parliament has unanimously approved a new Arctic security pact between Greenland, Denmark and the US in what it is hoped will mark a new chapter in relations, months after Donald Trump’s threats to invade the largely autonomous territory. The deal, which was signed by the US president and the prime ministers of Greenland and Denmark, Jens-Frederik Nielsen and Mette Frederiksen, in September after months of talks, updates a 1951 defence agreement to give the US underwater access to Greenland and specific permission to construct a missile defence system.
